cache_phase_benchmark.method: Warm remote cache; sequential old cache checks versus 20 queued concurrent new preparations; Python interpreter startup excluded.

burst_method: 950 local source jobs, four dummy routes with unlimited total/20 idle each, sleeping translation hooks that cannot submit remotely. Sampled for 20 seconds. Hook launches are asynchronous; observed ten simultaneous hooks, not eighty. All test jobs removed and manager/ProcD stopped afterward.
limitations: No unlimited-burst FD exhaustion was deliberately reproduced.
The vanished-PID diagnostic was observed without a master assertion; the reported race cause is unconfirmed.
Finite per-site idle limits do not guarantee a global descriptor bound for arbitrary numbers of sites or explicitly raised limits.
